"Success position se nahi, vision ki breadth se measure hoti."
"Inspiration amateur ko; baaki bas kaam pe."
"Insaan apne thoughts ka product hai."
Goal se zyada, tum kya bane wo zaruri hai.
Kal ko aaj par haavi mat hone do.
"Moon ko target karo; miss bhi karoge toh stars ke paas."
"Success habits pe banti."
Hum wohi hain jo sochte hain.
"Start karne ki himmat hai, success ki bhi hai."
Aisa mano aur kaam karo jaise fail hona namumkin hai.
Tumhara passion tumhare courage ka intezar kar raha hai.
Tum jaise ho, wahi kaafi ho.
